lines.text: Many learners say: She is taller then me.
Better: She is taller than me.
Than! He is older than me.

native.tip: „Then“ heißt „dann“. Beim Vergleich sagst du „than“: „taller than“.
native.caption: Verwechselst du „than“ und „then“? 🤏 Falsch: “She is taller then me.” Richtig: “She is taller than me.” Hör Carlos zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.caption: Do you mix up “than” and “then”? Wrong: “She is taller then me.” Right: “She is taller than me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
